title: Ledger 9 — Retention/deletion (did forgetting happen?)
description: arch §5 L9 + §5.3: GDPR deletion propagation over the lineage DAG. Tombstones at origin; propagation walks L3 derivation edges; promoted-skill ancestors flagged for re-derivation, never silently killed; third-party erasure enters identically; tombstones durable (offline nodes complete on reconnect); deadline-bound (one month).

request_id.description: The erasure request this record belongs to

requester_type.description: Who/what triggered erasure (arch §5.3 third-party erasure entry)

event.description: Which step of the propagation this record captures

origin_node.description: L3 target_id where the tombstone was planted

affected_node.description: The node this event applies to (descendant, skill, side-store ref)

deletion_kind.description: arch §5.3: a distilled pattern no longer containing the datum may survive; a memory quoting it does not

deadline.description: The one-month GDPR clock for this request (UTC)
